fact: The PASIU project manager said that Ouagadougou streets were renumbered by sector, the address database moved from paper to a digitised, geolocated database in which a household can be identified instantly, and nearly 16,000 streets were digitised.
title: Burkina : « Nous pouvons identifier un ménage à Ouagadougou à travers une base de données », Valentin Bayiri
